latest_release.name: v1.1.0
latest_release.body:
## Overview

ggml v1.1.0 extends the graph API for new model families, strengthens scheduler and backend behavior, and brings broad performance work across all backends. The API gains gated-delta-net replay, flash-attention indexed bias, ordered asynchronous host input copies, and scheduler scratch reservation, plus new SLEEP and SIGMOID_BACK operators. Core adds BF16 coverage for more operations, faster quantization and math helpers, and new CPU quant kernels, while backends add stream-k matmul, chunked command buffers, NVFP4, CONV_2D acceleration, wider FP8/BF16 support, and many tuning and correctness fixes.

### API changes

- Add SLEEP and SIGMOID_BACK ops (`ggml_sleep`, `ggml_sigmoid_back`); `GGML_OP_COUNT` is 101, RPC proto 10.0.2 [llama/27258](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27258) [llama/32126](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32126)
- Add indexed bias to FLASH_ATTN_EXT via `ggml_flash_attn_ext_add_indexed_bias()` and `..._has_indexed_bias()` [llama/32740](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32740) [llama/33016](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/33016)
- Add `ggml_gated_delta_net_ext()` with pending-token replay and deprecate `ggml_gated_delta_net()` [llama/31669](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31669)
- Add the `fast_async_host_input` device capability for host inputs copied asynchronously and ordered with the graph [llama/30685](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30685)
- Deprecate `ggml_ftype` and add `GGML_VERSION_{MAJOR,MINOR,PATCH}` macros plus the `ggml_tensor_t` typedef [llama/32647](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32647)

### Core changes

- Allow backends to reserve scratch memory in `graph_optimize` through a new `add_scratch` callback [llama/31898](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31898)
- Add a generic `ggml_backend_tensor_memset()` fallback; start a split at incompatible weights even without inputs [llama/32574](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32574) [llama/31775](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31775)
- RPC: add typed request helpers with a single validation step and reuse one context for request tensors on the server [llama/32651](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32651) [llama/32896](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32896)
- GGUF: reject invalid enum values created from untrusted file data [llama/32641](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32641)
- Add BF16 support to RMS_NORM, ROPE, ROPE_BACK and SET_ROWS on CPU and CUDA [llama/32135](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32135) [llama/32387](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32387)
- Speed up IQ2 quantization with pattern caching, F8_E4M3 decoding, and range-reduced log1p for softplus [llama/31910](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31910) [llama/32477](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32477) [llama/32655](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32655)
- CPU: add ARM repack kernels without dotprod, SVE q5_0/q5_1 and x86 VNNI Q2_0 dots, and multithread large GET_ROWS [llama/32142](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32142) [llama/30867](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30867) [llama/26348](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/26348) [llama/32514](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32514)
- CPU: reduce excessive polling on builds without OpenMP and improve the mul_mat memory access pattern [llama/32378](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32378) [llama/30846](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30846)
- WASM: use relaxed SIMD dot products [llama/19590](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/19590)
- llamafile: add QK and Q0 quant support for s390x [llama/32600](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32600) [llama/32203](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32203)
- KleidiAI: allow the OHOS AArch64 target and treat the sources as vendored [llama/32265](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/32265) [llama/32605]

# ggml
Tensor library for machine learning [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/ggml-org/ggml?filter=v*)](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/releases) [![CI](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/actions/workflows/build-cpu.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml/actions/workflows/build-cpu.yml)
## Quick start Build from source: ```bash git clone https://github.com/ggml-org/ggml cd ggml mkdir build && cd build cmake .. cmake --build . --config Release -j 8 ``` For a minimal, fully commented example (matrix multiplication), see [examples/simple](examples/simple). ## Description The main goal of `ggml` is to be a simple, portable, and efficient tensor library for machine learning with minimal setup. - Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies - Cross-platform - x86, ARM, RISC-V, LoongArch, PowerPC, s390x, and WebAssembly - SIMD-optimized kernels for x86, ARM, and RISC-V - Broad backend support - CPU, GPU, NPU, and browser - 2- to 8-bit integer quantization, plus MXFP4 and NVFP4 microscaling formats - Zero memory allocations during runtime ## Documentation - [The GGUF file format](docs/gguf.md) - [Introduction to ggml](https://huggingface.co/blog/introduction-to-ggml) - [GGML tips & tricks](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/wiki/GGML-Tips-&-Tricks) ## Contributing - For changes to the core `ggml` library (including to the CMake build system), please open a PR in [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) - doing so will make your PR more visible, better tested, and more likely to be reviewed
